verdict.rationale: ScrapingBee documents a first-party `cookies` parameter that passes custom cookies to the target page, which is the mechanism for fetching authenticated pages with your own session. The evidence is a single short parameter-table entry, and `session_id` only routes requests through the same IP, so it does not count toward cookie support. Missing for 10: cookie format and syntax details, any explicit statement that authenticated or logged-in pages are supported, behavior with JS rendering or headless sessions, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can pass my own session cookies so the API fetches pages requiring authentication

citations.quote: Pass custom cookies to the webpage you want to scrape
